summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for IBRANCE (palbociclib) NDA207103. The Medical Review states plainly that no advisory committee meeting was held, and both the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and the Office Director memo explain the application was not referred because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting discussion. With no committee, there are no AdCom-driven linkages to the approval.
